data.title: Ipswich Town vs Fulham prediction, preview & betting tips – 10/10/2026
data.content:
Gary O'Neil's side have picked up one win at home and another away, but they must tighten up defensively after conceding 11 goals already.

Ipswich have lost four of their last five matches across all competitions and need to find greater consistency if they are to break into the top 10, which would be a remarkable achievement.

Abdul Fatawu was sent off in their previous game and is suspended for this fixture, while Jack Taylor could return after a spell on the sidelines with a knee injury. [...] The Tractor Boys have picked up just two points in the Premier League so far, but they lost their last game against Everton before the international break.

Fulham, meanwhile, are yet to register a league win under Alvaro Arbeloa, although they have picked up back-to-back draws in their last two matches.

Read our prediction, preview and betting tips for the game below, and make sure to check out our today's betting tips page for more of our expert predictions. [...] Fulham made a disastrous start to the season, losing their opening three games under new manager Alvaro Arbeloa.

The Cottagers have regained some confidence after holding Liverpool to a goalless draw at Anfield before following it up with a 1-1 stalemate against Manchester United at Craven Cottage.

They are unbeaten in their last three matches across all competitions and have also avoided defeat in their previous nine meetings with Ipswich.
